title: Trump visit no quick fix for PH tariff troubles

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Manila and other United States trading partners should not get their hopes up that US President Donald Trump’s upcoming visit, along with the Republicans’ defeat in the midterm elections, will reverse Washington’s bruising tariff policies. That was the warning issued by Peter Mumford, an analyst who heads the Southeast Asia arm of Eurasia Group, as the Philippines prepares to welcome Trump on Nov. 17 at the close of this year’s Asean Summit.
